== Biography ==

The Caterpillar is a creature of Wonderland who occupies itself with smoking a hookah. When it speaks, its voice is languid and sleepy. The Caterpillar is disposed to inquiry, having asked Alice the straightforward question "Who are you?" upon their meeting. Alice, in her turn, recited the poem "You are old, Father William" to the Caterpillar, though in her recitation the verses came out differently. The two appear to have formed an acquaintance through this exchange.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Alice]]''' — acquaintance. The Caterpillar and Alice met in Wonderland when their eyes encountered one another; the Caterpillar spoke to her, and Alice later recited poetry to him.
